name: Signal Ahead
spec: yellow diamond with a black traffic-signal symbol showing red, yellow and green lenses
meaning: A traffic signal is ahead; be ready to stop.

snippets.back: Other warning signs announce a traffic signal ahead, a crossroad, a divided highway starting or ending, and a downhill grade.
One warning sign can mean either school crossing or school zone, and another warns of a traffic signal ahead.
A Traffic Signal Ahead sign warns of an upcoming signalized intersection and is used on roads with higher speeds or blocked views of the intersection or signal.
A stop-symbol advance warning indicates a stop ahead, while a traffic-light-symbol warning indicates a signal ahead.
Some warning signs announce a control device before you reach it, such as Stop Ahead, Yield Ahead and Signal Ahead.
A traffic signal ahead sign warns that the next intersection has a traffic light.
A Stop Ahead sign means a stop sign is coming on your road, and a Signal Ahead sign means a traffic light is coming; be ready to stop for either.
To change lanes, check the side and rear-view mirrors, look over your shoulder to clear the blind spot, signal ahead of time, and then move over.

result.summary: Meaning is directly supported - MO states Signal Ahead means a traffic light is coming; be ready to stop. No snippet states shape/colour (yellow diamond, lens colours).
